title: China-to-Pakistan Industrial Motor Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Pakistan Standards under PSQCA use PS standards for listed products and commonly adopt IEC 60034 concepts for rotating electrical machines. For industrial three-phase AC motors, exporters should map the motor type, rated output, duty, poles, enclosure, cooling method, and nameplate data to the applicable PS or PS/IEC 60034 standard before shipment.
target_standards: PSQCA Act and PS mandatory standards framework
PS / IEC 60034 series for rotating electrical machines
rows.china_equivalent: China commonly uses GB 18613 for IE efficiency classes, GB 12665 for cooling, and CCC for less-than-1 kV motors in CCC scope as the domestic baseline.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: China classification and CCC scope evidence does not automatically establish Pakistan PS standard coverage. The importer should confirm whether the exact motor category is listed for PSQCA conformity and whether the Pakistan file must reference PS/IEC 60034 rather than only GB documents.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory when the motor product is listed under PSQCA compulsory conformity requirements; otherwise product-specific verification is required
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for in-scope China efficiency and CCC obligations

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat PS/IEC 60034 classification as a Pakistan-specific file requirement and confirm PSQCA listing status before shipment.

source.publisher: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority

rows.requirement: Nameplate Ratings and 400 V 50 Hz Service
rows.target_requirement: Pakistan industrial supply is generally 400/230 V, three-phase, 50 Hz. Three-phase motors intended for Pakistan should show suitable 400 V 50 Hz ratings, permissible voltage tolerance, duty, connection, insulation class, IP rating, and efficiency class information aligned with the applicable PS/IEC 60034 documentation.
target_standards: NEPRA grid and electricity supply context
rows.china_equivalent: China industrial motors are commonly rated around 380 V, three-phase, 50 Hz, with GB 18613 efficiency marking, GB 12665 cooling data, and CCC where below 1 kV and in scope.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: Frequency is the same at 50 Hz, but Pakistan commonly uses 400 V three-phase service while many China domestic motors are marked 380 V. The exporter should verify thermal rise, torque, current, and efficiency at 400 V 50 Hz or document the permissible operating range.

mandatory_status.target: Practical market-access requirement and safety documentation expectation; mandatory where incorporated in the applicable PS standard or buyer utility specification
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for China domestic marking and safety certification where in scope

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] A 380 V China nameplate should not be assumed suitable for Pakistan 400 V service without documented voltage-range and performance evidence.

rows.target_requirement: Pakistan energy-efficiency direction for motors is associated with PSQCA and NEECA programmes, with IE class terminology aligned to IEC 60034-30-1. Export files should state the declared IE class, rated output, poles, frequency, test method, and whether the declared class is accepted for the exact Pakistan product category.
rows.china_equivalent: China GB 18613 defines IE efficiency classes aligned with IEC 60034-30-1 naming, while GB 12665 and CCC may appear in the same motor technical package for domestic China compliance.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: The IE class vocabulary is familiar in both markets, but a GB 18613 declaration is not the same as a Pakistan PSQCA or NEECA acceptance. The exporter should provide IEC 60034-30-1 mapping and confirm the Pakistan minimum class or programme requirement for the shipment category.

mandatory_status.target: Directionally mandatory where PSQCA or NEECA programme rules apply to the listed motor category; confirm category-level enforcement
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory under China GB 18613 for in-scope motors

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Do not rely on the China GB 18613 class alone; build a Pakistan file that maps the motor to IEC 60034-30-1 and the applicable PSQCA or NEECA programme expectation.

source.publisher: National Energy Efficiency and Conservation Authority

rows.target_requirement: For Pakistan submissions, the efficiency report should identify the test method used to support the IE class, preferably with IEC 60034-2-1 or an accepted PS/IEC equivalent where the Pakistan file relies on IEC 60034-30-1 class alignment. The report should match the exact model, rating, poles, duty, and frequency.
rows.china_equivalent: China technical files commonly include GB 18613 efficiency declarations and domestic test reports, plus GB 12665 cooling references and CCC records where the motor is within the China CCC low-voltage motor scope.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: A domestic China report may not specify IEC 60034-2-1 loss determination or may not test the motor at 400 V 50 Hz. Pakistan importers may need additional lab evidence or a standards crosswalk to support the PSQCA or buyer review.

mandatory_status.target: Documentation expectation for listed products and buyer or conformity review; exact compulsory status depends on PSQCA listing and programme rules
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory China evidence where GB 18613 and CCC scope apply

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Efficiency evidence should be traceable to the declared IE class and Pakistan operating rating, not only to a China domestic GB report.

rows.target_requirement: Where Pakistan efficiency or PSQCA requirements apply, product information should identify the efficiency class, rated efficiency, rated output, voltage, frequency, number of poles, duty type, and manufacturer or importer details. Importers should confirm whether any Pakistan label, certificate reference, or Urdu or English information format is required for the listed category.
rows.china_equivalent: China motor marking commonly references GB 18613 IE efficiency information, GB 12665 cooling information, and CCC marks or certificate references when the motor is within CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: China nameplate and CCC references may omit Pakistan importer, PS certificate, local language, or PSQCA certificate details. Re-labelling or supplemental documentation may be needed before customs clearance or sale.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where specified by the applicable PSQCA certificate, PS standard, import condition, or NEECA programme
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for China domestic marking where GB 18613 and CCC scope apply

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Plan a Pakistan-specific marking review before shipment because China CCC or GB markings are not a substitute for PSQCA or importer information.

source.publisher: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority

rows.target_requirement: Pakistan motor conformity files may need EMC evidence where the motor, drive, controller, or integrated electronics are assessed as an electrical product or system under PSQCA, buyer, or utility requirements. For a bare induction motor, EMC risk is usually lower than for a variable-speed drive package, but the applicable PS or IEC test basis should still be documented.
target_standards: IEC 61800-3 for adjustable speed electrical power drive systems where applicable
rows.china_equivalent: China motor files may include GB 18613 efficiency evidence, GB 12665 cooling evidence, and CCC records for less-than-1 kV in-scope motors; EMC evidence for drive packages may be covered separately from the motor body.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: China motor CCC or GB evidence may not cover the EMC behavior of a Pakistan-bound motor and VSD package. If the shipped product includes an inverter, controller, sensor, or smart module, EMC evidence should be prepared for the complete configuration.

mandatory_status.target: Product-specific; mandatory where the applicable PSQCA listing, PS standard, utility requirement, or buyer specification requires EMC evidence
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for China CCC or EMC obligations where the complete product is in scope

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] For Pakistan, define whether the shipment is a bare motor or a motor-drive system before deciding the EMC test package.

source.publisher: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority

rows.target_requirement: If the motor product includes wireless monitoring, cellular, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, remote telemetry, or other radio modules, Pakistan Telecommunications Authority approval may be relevant in addition to PSQCA motor conformity. Radio module approval should be assessed separately from motor efficiency or safety certification.
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic motor evidence may include GB 18613, GB 12665, and CCC for the motor, while radio modules may be subject to separate China radio or network access approvals outside the motor baseline.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: A China motor certificate is not evidence of PTA acceptance for radio functions. Pakistan-bound smart motors should separate the motor PSQCA file from the radio module or connected-device approval file.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where radio or telecom equipment approval is triggered
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for China domestic radio or CCC obligations where in scope

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Smart or connected motors may need a separate Pakistan PTA review even when the motor body has PSQCA documentation.

rows.requirement: PSQCA Mandatory Certification for Listed Products
rows.target_requirement: PSQCA administers Pakistan standards and mandatory conformity for listed products. For industrial motors, the importer should confirm whether the exact product is on the current compulsory list and obtain the required PSQCA conformity certificate or permission before import or sale.
target_standards: PSQCA Act and compulsory standards framework
Applicable Pakistan Standard for the listed motor category
rows.china_equivalent: China baseline evidence may include GB 18613 efficiency, GB 12665 cooling, and CCC for less-than-1 kV motors in CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: Pakistan does not treat China CCC as automatic market approval. If the motor is on the PSQCA compulsory list, a Pakistan-specific certificate or conformity decision is needed even when the product has China GB and CCC documents.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for products listed under PSQCA compulsory conformity requirements
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for China domestic CCC or GB obligations where in scope

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Confirm the current PSQCA compulsory listing before shipment; CCC is useful evidence but not a Pakistan approval.

source.publisher: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority

rows.target_requirement: Pakistan import clearance is handled through FBR and customs processes. For listed products, customs may require PSQCA conformity evidence, commercial documents, HS classification, importer details, certificate references, and any applicable duties or import controls before release.
target_standards: PSQCA conformity certificate for listed products
rows.china_equivalent: China export packages commonly include commercial documents plus GB 18613, GB 12665, and CCC evidence where relevant, but those documents do not replace Pakistan customs or PSQCA import requirements.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: The shipping file must be converted from China domestic compliance evidence into a Pakistan import file. Missing PSQCA certificate references, importer data, or correct HS classification can delay clearance even if the motor is technically sound.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for import clearance when customs, FBR, PSQCA, or product listing rules require the documents
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory for China export and domestic evidence where applicable

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Prepare a Pakistan import file early; China technical certificates alone do not clear Pakistan customs.

rows.target_requirement: Pakistan enforcement can vary by product category, port, programme status, and whether the item appears on a current PSQCA compulsory list. Exporters should not infer non-enforcement from another electrical product category or earlier shipment experience.
rows.china_equivalent: China domestic compliance is based on whether GB 18613, GB 12665, and CCC scope apply to the product, but this scope analysis does not determine Pakistan enforcement practice.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: Pakistan enforcement uncertainty creates a planning risk. The safer approach is to classify the product, confirm current listing status with the importer or PSQCA channel, and prepare certificate evidence before the goods arrive.

mandatory_status.target: Variable by category, but mandatory when the product is listed or a customs condition applies
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China GB or CCC scope applies

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat category-specific Pakistan listing checks as a shipment gate, not as a post-arrival clean-up item.

source.publisher: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety and Rotating Machine Construction
rows.target_requirement: Pakistan safety review for industrial motors should address PS/IEC 60034 construction expectations, insulation, temperature rise, protection degree, terminals, earthing, creepage and clearance where relevant, and suitability for 400/230 V 50 Hz service.
rows.china_equivalent: China common evidence includes GB 18613 efficiency, GB 12665 cooling and thermal-related documentation, and CCC for less-than-1 kV motors in CCC scope.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: China safety and CCC evidence may need a PS/IEC 60034 crosswalk for Pakistan. Particular attention is needed where a 380 V China model is sold for 400 V Pakistan operation because current, heating, insulation margin, and terminal ratings should remain acceptable.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for listed products and for any PSQCA certificate or buyer acceptance requiring PS/IEC 60034 safety evidence
mandatory_status.cn: Mandatory where China CCC or national standards apply

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Build a Pakistan safety file that maps the China motor evidence to PS/IEC 60034 and the 400 V 50 Hz operating case.

source.publisher: Pakistan Standards and Quality Control Authority

rows.requirement: Installation, Grid Interface, and NEPRA Context
rows.target_requirement: NEPRA regulates Pakistan power-sector context, while site connection is normally handled through distribution company and electrical installation requirements. Motor documentation for Pakistan projects should identify starting current, protection, earthing, power factor, harmonic impact where drives are used, and compatibility with 400/230 V 50 Hz supply.
target_standards: NEPRA power-sector regulations and distribution context
rows.china_equivalent: China documents often focus on GB 18613 efficiency, GB 12665 cooling, and CCC for in-scope low-voltage motors, with installation and grid-study evidence prepared separately for the project.
china_standards: CCC for in-scope motors below 1 kV
rows.gap: A product certificate does not by itself prove site-level grid compatibility. For large motors or drive systems, Pakistan project files may need starting method, protection coordination, harmonic, or distribution-company acceptance information beyond the China compliance file.

mandatory_status.target: Project-specific; mandatory where NEPRA, distribution company, electrical installation, or buyer requirements apply
mandatory_status.cn: Project-specific in addition to mandatory China product rules where in scope

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] For Pakistan projects, keep product PSQCA evidence separate from site grid-connection evidence and address both before commissioning.
